page.overview:
What is City Guard?

The City Guard of Vizima are the armed forces in charge of protecting the city and surrounding outskirts.

In , three members of the guard arrived to The Fox tavern upon hearing a fight, and found the witcher Geralt of Rivia, who was arrested and after using mind control to sway the guards, was led to Castellan Velerad.

Standard arms used by the guards include truncheons wound in leather straps and a sword. However, others are known to carry pikes and crossbows.

In , city guards are stationed at all gates and also roam the streets. They also help Geralt fight salamanders and other monsters if they happen to be nearby. Their default behavior is to help the witcher. They are based out of the city dungeon. The captain of the City Guard is Vincent Meis.
